actions.description: Copy a file to a different folder in Box.
actions.name: copy-file

file_id.description: The ID of the file to copy. Example: "123456789"

parent_folder_id.description: The ID of the destination folder. Example: "987654321"

name.description: An optional new name for the copied file. If not provided, the original name is used.

actions.description: Copy a folder and its contents to a different location in Box.
actions.name: copy-folder

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder to copy. Example: "382204778319"

destination_folder_id.description: The ID of the destination folder where the folder will be copied. Example: "0"

name.description: Optional new name for the copied folder. If not provided, the original name will be used with " (copy)" appended.

actions.description: Create a collaboration in Box
actions.name: create-collaboration

item_type.description: The type of item to grant access to. Example: "folder"

item_id.description: The ID of the item to grant access to. Example: "382205380769"

accessible_by_type.description: The type of collaborator to invite. Example: "user"

accessible_by_id.description: The ID of the user or group to invite. Use this OR accessible_by_login, not both. Example: "23522323"

accessible_by_login.description: The email address of the user to invite. Use this OR accessible_by_id, not both. Example: "john@example.com"

role.description: The level of access granted. Example: "editor"

is_access_only.description: If true, collaborators have access but items are not visible in All Files list. Example: true

can_view_path.description: If true, invited users can see the entire parent path to the folder. Example: true

expires_at.description: Expiration date for the collaboration in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2019-08-29T23:59:00-07:00"

notify.description: Whether to notify the user of the invitation. Example: true

actions.description: Create a comment in Box.
actions.name: create-comment

file_id.description: The ID of the file to comment on. Example: "2231568666314"

actions.description: Create a folder in Box
actions.name: create-folder

name.description: The name of the folder. Example: "My New Folder"

parent_folder_id.description: The ID of the parent folder. Use "0" for the root folder. Example: "382205380769"

id.description: The unique identifier of the folder

parent_id.description: The ID of the parent folder

created_at.description: The timestamp when the folder was created

modified_at.description: The timestamp when the folder was last modified

path_collection.description: The path from the root to this folder

actions.description: Creates a user in Box. Requires an enterprise account.
actions.name: create-user

name.description: The full name of the user. Example: "Jane Doe"

login.description: The email address the user uses to log in. Example: "jane@example.com"

language.description: The language of the user in ISO 639-1 format.

is_sync_enabled.description: Whether the user can use Box Sync.

space_amount.description: The user's total available space in bytes.

can_see_managed_users.description: Whether the user can see other enterprise users in their contact list.

is_external_collab_restricted.description: Whether the user is restricted from collaborating with users outside their enterprise.

is_exempt_from_device_limits.description: Whether to exempt the user from enterprise device limits.

is_exempt_from_login_verification.description: Whether the user must use two-factor authentication.

is_platform_access_only.description: Whether the user is an App User.

external_app_user_id.description: An external identifier for an app user.

actions.description: Delete or archive a collaboration in Box
actions.name: delete-collaboration

collaboration_id.description: The ID of the collaboration to delete. Example: "72837978884"

actions.description: Delete or archive a comment in Box
actions.name: delete-comment

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to delete. Example: "12345"

success.description: Whether the comment was successfully deleted

actions.description: Deletes a user in Box. Requires an enterprise account.
actions.name: delete-user

user_id.description: The ID of the user to delete. Example: "12345"

force.description: Whether to force the deletion even if the user has content. Defaults to false.

notify.description: Whether to notify the user that they have been removed. Defaults to false.

user_id.description: The ID of the deleted user

actions.description: Delete or archive a file in Box
actions.name: delete-file

file_id.description: The unique identifier for the file to delete. Example: "123456789"

force_delete.description: If true, permanently deletes the file bypassing the trash. If false or omitted, the file is moved to trash.

actions.description: Delete or archive a folder in Box
actions.name: delete-folder

folderId.description: The ID of the folder to delete. Example: "382204778319"

recursive.description: Whether to delete the folder and all its contents. If false and folder is not empty, the operation will fail. Defaults to true.

folderId.description: The ID of the deleted folder

actions.description: Download file content from Box
actions.name: download-file

file_id.description: The ID of the file to download. Example: "123456789"

content.description: The file content as a base64-encoded string

file_id.description: The ID of the downloaded file

actions.description: Fetches the top-level content (files and folders) of a folder given its ID. If no folder ID is provided, it fetches content from the root folder.
actions.name: folder-content

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder to fetch content from. Defaults to the root folder ("0"). Example: "123456789"

marker.description: A pagination cursor returned by a previous call. Use this to fetch the next page of results.

actions.description: Retrieve a single collaboration from Box.
actions.name: get-collaboration

collaboration_id.description: The ID of the collaboration. Example: "1234"

actions.description: Retrieve a single comment from Box
actions.name: get-comment

comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to retrieve. Example: "12345"

actions.description: Retrieve a single file from Box
actions.name: get-file

file_id.description: The unique identifier of the file. Example: "12345"

actions.description: Retrieve a single folder from Box.
actions.name: get-folder

folder_id.description: The unique identifier that represent a folder. The root folder is always represented by the ID 0. Example: "12345"

actions.description: Retrieve a single user from Box
actions.name: get-user

user_id.description: The ID of the user. Example: "123"

actions.description: List collaborations from Box. Retrieves pending collaboration invites for this user.
actions.name: list-collaborations

status.description: The status of the collaborations to retrieve. Defaults to pending.

offset.description: The offset of the item at which to begin the response.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

actions.description: List comments for a file
actions.name: list-comments

file_id.description: The unique identifier of the file. Example: "12345"

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return per page. Default: 100.

offset.description: The 0-based offset of the first item to return. Default: 0.

actions.description: List files from Box.
actions.name: list-files

folder_id.description: The unique identifier for the folder. The root folder is always represented by the ID `0`. Example: "0"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return per page. Maximum is 1000.

sort.description: Defines the second attribute by which items are sorted.

direction.description: The direction to sort results in.

actions.description: List folders from Box
actions.name: list-folders

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder to list items from. Use "0" for the root folder. Defaults to "0".

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return per page. Maximum is 1000.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: Search for files, folders, and other content in Box
actions.name: search

query.description: The string to search for. This query is matched against item names, descriptions, text content of files, and various other fields.

type.description: Limits the search results to items of this type.

file_extensions.description: Limits results to files matching any of the provided extensions (comma-separated list without dots).

ancestor_folder_ids.description: Limits results to items within the given folders (comma-separated list of folder IDs).

created_at_range.description: Limits results to items created within a date range (comma-separated RFC3339 timestamps).

updated_at_range.description: Limits results to items updated within a date range (comma-separated RFC3339 timestamps).

size_range.description: Limits results to items within a file size range (comma-separated byte sizes).

owner_user_ids.description: Limits results to items owned by the given users (comma-separated list of user IDs).

recent_updater_user_ids.description: Limits results to items recently updated by the given users (comma-separated list of user IDs).

content_types.description: Limits search to match specific content parts (comma-separated list).

trash_content.description: Determines if the search should look in trash. Defaults to non_trashed_only.

sort.description: Defines the order of search results. Defaults to relevance.

direction.description: Defines the direction of ordering. Defaults to DESC.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 30, max 200.

offset.description: The offset of the first item to return. Defaults to 0.

scope.description: Limits results to user content or enterprise content. Defaults to user_content.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response.

include_recent_shared_links.description: Whether to include items accessed through shared links.

deleted_user_ids.description: Limits results to items deleted by the given users (requires trash_content=trashed_only).

deleted_at_range.description: Limits results to items deleted within a date range (requires trash_content=trashed_only).

actions.description: Update a collaboration in Box
actions.name: update-collaboration

collaboration_id.description: The ID of the collaboration. Example: "12345678"

status.description: Set the status of a pending collaboration invitation, effectively accepting or rejecting the invite.

expires_at.description: Update the expiration date for the collaboration. Format: ISO 8601 date-time. Example: "2019-08-29T23:59:00-07:00"

can_view_path.description: Determines if the invited users can see the entire parent path to the associated folder. Only for folder collaborations.

actions.description: Update a comment in Box
actions.name: update-comment

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to update. Example: "12345"

message.description: The new text of the comment. Example: "Updated comment message"

actions.description: Update a file in Box. This can be used to rename or move a file.
actions.name: update-file

file_id.description: The unique identifier that represents a file. Example: "2231571097476"

name.description: An optional different name for the file. This can be used to rename the file.

description.description: The description for a file. Max length 256 characters.

parent.description: An optional new parent folder for the file. This can be used to move the file to a new folder.

id.description: The ID of parent folder. Use "0" for the root folder.

tags.description: The tags for this item. There is a limit of 100 tags per item.

actions.description: Update a folder in Box.
actions.name: update-folder

folder_id.description: The unique identifier for the folder to update. Example: "12345"

name.description: The new name for the folder.

description.description: The optional description of this folder.

parent_id.description: The ID of the new parent folder to move this folder into.

can_non_owners_invite.description: Specifies if users who are not the owner of the folder can invite new collaborators.

is_collaboration_restricted_to_enterpris.description: Specifies if new invites to this folder are restricted to users within the enterprise.

can_non_owners_view_collaborators.description: Restricts collaborators who are not the owner from viewing other collaborations on this folder.

actions.description: Update a user in Box
actions.name: update-user

user_id.description: The ID of the user to update. Example: "12345"

login.description: The email address the user uses to log in.

language.description: The language of the user in ISO 639-1 format.

is_sync_enabled.description: Whether the user can use Box Sync.

can_see_managed_users.description: Whether the user can see other enterprise users in their contact list.

is_external_collab_restricted.description: Whether the user is allowed to collaborate with users outside their enterprise.

is_exempt_from_device_limits.description: Whether to exempt the user from enterprise device limits.

is_exempt_from_login_verification.description: Whether the user must use two-factor authentication.

is_password_reset_required.description: Whether the user is required to reset their password.

space_amount.description: The user's total available space in bytes. Set to -1 for unlimited storage.

external_app_user_id.description: An external identifier for an app user.

syncs.description: Sync the metadata of specified files or folder paths from Box. A file or folder ID can be provided.
syncs.name: files

syncs.description: Fetches a list of users from Box. Requires an enterprise account.
syncs.name: users
